title: Refund Window
body: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery for unopened items, 14 days for electronics.

title: Tone Guidelines
body: Responses must be empathetic, never combative. Acknowledge the customer's feelings before stating policy.

title: Shipping Inquiries
body: Provide carrier name, tracking number, and current ETA. Do not promise dates earlier than the carrier's estimate.

title: Complaint Handling
body: Complaints must always be reviewed by a human escalations agent before sending; the verifier flags any auto-resolved complaint as needs_revision.

title: Product Questions
body: Answer with documented product facts only. If unsure, escalate to the product team. Do not invent specifications.

title: PII
body: Never include credit-card numbers, full mailing addresses, or government IDs in outbound responses.
